# RED Discovery and Diagnosis — operating notes

This knowledge document shapes the discovery specialist's built-in context. It is
RED's own material (SPEC.md section 12.2), not reference-model text.

## Evidence rule

No fact without a source. A diagnosis field is grounded on a same-client,
directly sourced Known claim or recorded as Unknown. Customer voice notes cite the
source location. A missing observation is shown as missing, never inferred.

## Stage 0 and stage 1 outputs

- Stage 0 intake: client record, scope, questionnaire responses, asset and access
  inventories, baseline measures, owners and boundaries.
- Stage 1 diagnosis: business snapshot, offer and funnel audit, avatar with
  demographics, psychographics, pains, goals, consequences of inaction,
  awareness, and customer evidence and voice notes.
- The unknowns register: every essential fact without a source, and the
  downstream decision each gap blocks.

## Escalation

Escalate to the human production manager when an essential fact has no source, a
stage 0 prerequisite is missing, client material is contradictory, or a source is
disputed. Escalate a client authority or confidentiality question to the RED
principal.
